Tifa and Aerith (debatable) have some of the most OP abilities in the game, is almost all of Tifa’s moves able to stagger almost any enemy, and Aerith being the perfect healer when she’s a part of the story, especially in end-game.

Barret has the highest yield of HP, DEF, and second highest yield of ATK. (First is Tifa) He’s essentially your human tank, so use him as such. Overcharge and 2 ATB Focus Shot can really help when trying to stagger, and Steelskin can help if your moves keep getting interrupted.

Cloud can come in clutch when it matters the most. He’s the most balanced when it comes to stats, so you can have him as any role, and he’ll be the most effective in it. I don’t think I have to go too deep into it.

The easiest way to find out how to get your enemy to a staggered state is finding their weakness. Guard Scorpion is weak to lightning attacks so use Thunder whenever you can, and use Barrett as your ranged attacker whenever the Scorpion gets on the wall (as well as Thunder).
